header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
Mr. Om Parkash H. Karmani advocate for the petitioner.
Mr. Ghulamullah Memon, A.A.G a/w Inspector Ali
body: Through instant Petition, the petitioner is seeking removal of encroachment; for which he has also filed an application under section 133 Cr.P.C before the concerned Magistrate. Inspector Ali Asghar Jarwar, S.H.O P.S Talhi, present in court, also submits that parties have patched-up their dispute outside the court. Since same remedy has already been availed by the petitioner before the concerned Magistrate, therefore, instant Petition being non-maintainable is hereby dismissed.
